sourceTitle: South Kingstown: 6. POLICE DEPARTMENT RULES AND REGULATIONS – TOWN COUNCIL APPROVAL
exactQuestion: Shall Sec. 4414.4 of the Town Charter be amended to provide that the Chief of Police may issue rules and regulations for the conduct of all members of the Police Department without being required to receive Town Council approval for such rules and regulations?
